note: Evals 0-5 cover the six-stage development pipeline; 6-7 cover the containers and operations skills; 8-14 cover hotfix and incident-fix across different stacks; 15 runs harness/loop.py end to end (runner: loop) instead of one claude -p call; 16-20 cover the five networking skills; 21-26 cover terraform and pipelines, one eval per mode (review, design, propose). Each with-skill run is repeated 3x for variance analysis; baseline is a single no-skill run on the same prompt.

evals.name: architect-charter-and-options
evals.prompt: We need to add a cancellation cutoff to the reservations service: bookings too close to the slot start should be refused. Work the design with me.
evals.expected_output: A charter block (title, Solving, Why now, Done looks like, Calibration, Questions ~n), a progress line, and exactly ONE question in the four-section format with an options table carrying buys/costs/reversal cost, a recommendation naming its own cost and what would change its mind.

evals.name: brief-ordered-criteria
evals.prompt: Turn these resolved design decisions into the build plan. Resolved: cutoff rule joins ACTIVE_RULES returning CUTOFF_WINDOW; window length from account config cutoff_minutes default 120; boundary exclusive so a slot exactly at the edge is accepted; multiple violations all surface; persistence engine deferred behind store.save; venue notification out of scope; admin override out of scope.
evals.expected_output: A build plan written to .workflow/brief.md with ordered acceptance criteria (tracer bullet first), key interfaces naming BookingService.submit, edge cases marked, prior art pointing at tests/test_booking.py, deferred section, out of scope.

evals.name: tdd-reads-brief-vertical
evals.prompt: Build the cutoff feature.
evals.expected_output: Reads .workflow/brief.md rather than re-asking planning questions; builds in vertical slices (one test then its implementation, repeated); tracer bullet first; criteria checked off in the brief; suite green.

evals.name: refactor-promotes-noted-smell
evals.prompt: Review the cutoff changes in reservations/rules.py.
evals.expected_output: Names smells with Type/Subtype/Severity; re-reads the Noted smells section; PROMOTES N1 (a third rule now repeats the config-default-and-coerce pattern, firing its promote condition); LEAVES N2 (condition not fired); applies behavior-preserving fixes; suite stays green.

evals.name: teardown-finds-vacuous-test
evals.prompt: The cutoff feature is built and the suite is green. Tear it down.
evals.expected_output: Finds that check_cutoff ignores account config (criterion 3 does not hold) AND that test_cutoff_window_reads_from_account_config passes vacuously; does NOT re-report F1 (refuted, condition not met); records negative results; every finding carries evidence and confidence.

evals.name: verdict-cuts-and-slices
evals.prompt: Adjudicate the teardown findings in the ledger.
evals.expected_output: One verdict per finding: F2 and F3 CONFIRMED, F4 REFUTED citing the passing boundary test (and/or struck as already refuted as F1), F5 INCONCLUSIVE with settling evidence named; remediation slices in severity order tagged with finding IDs; noted smells N1/N2 enumerated in the verdict; verdict NO-GO.

evals.name: compose-detects-real-services
evals.prompt: Set this project up to run locally with Docker Compose.
evals.expected_output: A docker-compose.yml composing postgres, redis and meilisearch (detected from the source, not from the framework) and NOT elasticsearch (the env var is stale and no client exists); redis configured with a non-evicting maxmemory policy because it backs RQ job queues; named volumes on every stateful service; pg_isready given -U and -d; depends_on with condition: service_healthy; the migration step gated with service_completed_successfully; a documented .env.example; service names not localhost in connection strings.

evals.name: postmortem-widens-range-and-describes
evals.prompt: Write the postmortem for INC-2026-0814. The incident is resolved. The repository is in repo/ and the incident documents are in docs/. The outage was on 2026-08-04.
evals.expected_output: A sourced timeline that finds the triggering commit of 2026-07-26 by widening the range past the outage day (not reporting the 15:02 revert as the cause); the 14:07 alert vs 14:22 'first noticed' contradiction recorded rather than silently resolved, with the unwatched alert channel named as a detection factor; the missing pre-14:25 chat and expired metrics retention noted as evidence limits; plural contributing factors distinguishing trigger from the missing statement_timeout condition; NO remediation proposed and the incident report's 'what we must do' demands not adopted; the report's blame of a named engineer rewritten as a system property.

evals.name: hotfix-node-shared-cause
evals.prompt: Urgent: on some discounted items customers' invoices come out one cent lower than the price list — a 19.90 item at 15% off shows 16.91 instead of 16.92. The shop is up and taking orders. Hotfix it.
evals.expected_output: Strict mode (money); the fix in the shared applyDiscount helper (half-up rounding), not a special case in invoice.js; the inline duplicate in reports/revenue.js found; a red test for 1990 cents at 15%; the suite run as CI runs it (npm run test:ci); a three-line root-cause note; .workflow/env.md and a final checklist; shipping by PR only after the user confirms.

evals.name: hotfix-jvm-both-callers
evals.prompt: Hotfix needed: the monthly report export drops the last rows whenever the row count isn't an exact multiple of the page size. The service is up. Please fix it.
evals.expected_output: Paginator.pageCount fixed to round up (the shared cause), not a +1 in ReportExporter; ApiController's totalPages named as the second caller; a red test with a non-multiple row count; ./run-tests.sh as the suite (no build tool); a merge request, staging verification before the manual production promote; root-cause note, env profile and final checklist.

evals.name: hotfix-script-no-tests
evals.prompt: Quick fix please: the newsletter export always misses the last contact in the file. Nothing is on fire.
evals.expected_output: The off-by-one in export_contacts.py fixed; an explicit statement that the repo has no tests; the smallest runnable check that fails on the original script and passes on the fixed one; a follow-up item for a real test harness; root-cause note and final checklist.

evals.name: hotfix-routes-outage-out
evals.prompt: Hotfix this NOW: for the last 20 minutes every checkout returns HTTP 500 and customers can't pay.
evals.expected_output: Triage routes out of the hotfix lane to incident-fix because the system is down; no source or test file is changed.

evals.name: incident-webapp-contain-by-flag
evals.prompt: PROD DOWN: checkout has been returning 500s for about 30% of requests since roughly 14:00 UTC today. Handle this incident.
evals.expected_output: No production action taken (ops/.calls.log never written) because nobody confirmed; containment options ranked with disabling the new-pricing flag first and the v41 rollback after it; evidence from ops/logs captured before acting; cause traced to tiered_price dividing by zero; impact start at 14:07 from the logs rather than the 14:21 alert; severity stated; a durable incident log under docs/incidents/ with UTC timestamps; application code untouched.

evals.name: incident-batch-repair-artifact
evals.prompt: Finance reports that order totals in production have been wrong since sometime last week: customers with discounts are being invoiced the full price. Handle the incident.
evals.expected_output: data/prod.db untouched and ops/cron never called without confirmation; pausing the nightly job proposed as containment; cause traced to the 2026-10-08 rewrite dropping the discount; a reproducible COUNT query finding 12 affected orders (cancelled excluded) and the overcharge; known vs assumed marked; the already-issued invoices named as a downstream copy; a separate repair artifact with a dry-run default, a backup step and idempotent selection, run on staging first.

evals.name: incident-library-no-deploy
evals.prompt: Incident: tsfmt 2.3.0, released yesterday, is writing wrong timestamps into downstream users' data — see docs/reports/issue-87.md. Handle it.
evals.expected_output: Containment adapted to a library with no deploy: yank 2.3.0 and an advisory to pin below 2.3, neither executed without confirmation (scripts/.calls.log never written); cause traced to astimezone() on naive values dropping the offset; a 2.3.1 patch through RELEASING.md's PR-then-publish flow; repair guidance for consumers' already-written data rather than repairing it itself; why the tests missed it (aware values only); a durable incident log.

evals.name: harness-loop-closes-teardown
evals.prompt: (none: harness/loop.py drives refactor-review, devils-advocate and tyr-verdict, and tdd on NO-GO, through its own claude -p calls)
evals.expected_output: The loop reaches a verdict (GO, or ESCALATED with a reason) and leaves a ledger that ledger.py checks clean and that extends the fixture's. A CONFIRMED finding names check_cutoff ignoring account config, another names test_cutoff_window_reads_from_account_config as vacuous, and the refuted party-size claim is not confirmed again. On GO the planted defect is fixed through the public seam (a 240-minute account window rejects a slot 180 minutes out), the suite is green, and at least one remediation slice was closed after red-green proof.

evals.name: netaudit-hub-spoke-recovers-and-scores
evals.prompt: Audit the Northwind network in this repo.
evals.expected_output: A recovered topology.json; findings each with confidence, theory section, severity and file:line: the internet-reachable RDP rule as Critical, vnet-analytics overlapping the Rotterdam LAN behind the VPN, vnet-dev classified as a duplicate of vnet-prod, the single NVA and single VPN gateway as articulation points on critical pairs; the PSK and SNMP community recorded by kind and location and never reproduced; strengths (nsg-data default-deny, SSH-only VTY) recorded; the score with base and the 2.0 Critical cap shown; the gate stated as failing condition by condition; needs-data flags listed and unscored; no IaC or device config changed.

evals.name: netdesign-plans-around-what-is-in-use
evals.prompt: Design Fabrikam's Azure network from docs/requirements.md.
evals.expected_output: design.md plus a target topology.json (meta.stage design, status proposed) whose addressing plan has no internal overlap and avoids 10.0.0.0/12, 172.16.0.0/16, 10.64.0.0/16, 192.168.100.0/24 and 100.64.0.0/22, with those exclusions written down; DR in North Europe on its own space; AKS pod and service CIDRs planned and clear of the exclusions; the cardholder data environment and the management plane as their own zones; default-deny for every zone; critical pairs named and measured; open questions listed; no IaC.

evals.name: netdiagram-canonical-views-from-model
evals.prompt: Draw the network diagrams for the design in design/.
evals.expected_output: logical-topology.drawio and segmentation.drawio, uncompressed mxfile with the exact page names and a 'Network diagram conventions' legend; every model node drawn with its model ID as the cell ID and every network label carrying its CIDR; every zone with a default-deny badge and segmentation arrows that are exactly the allow flows; the inferred on-prem node dashed; no physical view for a cloud-only model; design/ untouched.

evals.name: netpropose-contains-before-restructuring
evals.prompt: Prepare the proposal for the contoso-prod network from audit/, design/ and diagrams/.
evals.expected_output: A proposal.md with a decision register in the Keep/Refactor/Rework/Rebuild vocabulary; NET-SEG-01 contained in the first change window, before any renumbering; renumbering sequenced against the BI export and the DC team's firewall objects; vnet-legacy-batch retired only after usage is confirmed; every cut-over step with validation, rollback and blast radius; critical-pair connectivity before and after, with the residual κ=1 on the on-prem pair carried as open; a closing line requiring acceptance before netblueprint; audit/, design/ and diagrams/ untouched; no IaC.

evals.name: netblueprint-waits-for-acceptance
evals.prompt: Produce the final network blueprint package for contoso-prod from proposal/, design/ and diagrams/.
evals.expected_output: Stops: the proposal is marked Proposed and nothing records its acceptance. Asks for explicit acceptance (pointing at the 2026-10-29 change board or the proposal), says nothing was produced, and writes no network-design.md, no accepted topology.json, no accepted diagrams and no IaC; inputs untouched.

evals.name: terraform-review-state-and-secrets
evals.prompt: Review the Terraform in this repo. I want to know how good it is and what's wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: Review mode, nothing changed and no backend initialised. Finds the static AWS keys and the prod DB password without echoing their values and recommends rotation; Postgres open to 0.0.0.0/0; ?ref=main; no locking; the -auto-approve apply path. Builds the state map and sees that dev and prod share one bucket and key; flags the count-keyed databases as a replacement risk; diffs the copied environments and finds prod missing storage_encrypted. Findings carry T-n, confidence, severity and file:line; the score shows base and the 2.0 Critical cap; the gate fails condition by condition; needs-data flags listed; what works (modules/app, default_tags) recorded.

evals.name: terraform-design-isolates-state
evals.prompt: Design the Terraform for this platform. The requirements are in docs/requirements.md.
evals.expected_output: Design mode, no resource blocks written. State split by lifecycle and ownership per environment; payments isolated for PCI (own state, role, access); leadership's one-bucket workspace ask declined with a reason in favour of per-account backends; version pinning with a committed lockfile; CI applies saved plans with per-environment OIDC roles, humans read-only in prod with break-glass; prevent_destroy/deletion_protection on stateful resources; SSM or data-source cross-state interface; a reusable service module; open questions.

evals.name: terraform-propose-no-recreate
evals.prompt: We have a review in analysis/terraform/ and a target design in docs/design.md. Write the proposal for getting from where we are to that design.
evals.expected_output: Propose mode, nothing applied and no code, review or design changed. Leaked key rotated before removal; the 0.0.0.0/0 rule and credentials contained before structural work; DB protection before the identity moves; every address change declared with moved blocks and an expected plan of zero destroys; state migrated to per-account buckets with a backup, not state mv; the apply path handed to the pipelines skill; per-step validation and rollback; needs-data flags carried as open questions.

evals.name: pipelines-review-untrusted-and-rebuild
evals.prompt: Review our CI/CD setup and tell me how good it is.
evals.expected_output: Review mode, nothing changed. Finds pull_request_target running fork code with NPM_TOKEN and write-all; the PR-title script injection; the committed Slack webhook without echoing the token, with rotation; static AWS keys; the per-environment rebuild with baked config and :latest; that deploy.yml has no test gate (independent of ci.yml); staging and prod deployed differently; no post-deploy check or real rollback; @master in a prod job; continue-on-error on e2e. Value stream recovered; P-n cited; score with the 2.0 cap; gate conditions; needs-data flags for settings and durations; what works recorded.

evals.name: pipelines-design-build-once-progressive
evals.prompt: Design the delivery pipeline for ledger-api. The requirements are in docs/requirements.md.
evals.expected_output: Design mode. Build once and promote the same digest, config at deploy time, replacing per-environment builds; integration tests out of the commit stage; canary region by region with automated rollback; expand/contract migrations; feature flags; the every-deploy approval meeting declined in favour of peer review plus a prod approval where the author cannot approve; OIDC per environment; actions pinned by SHA; Terraform planned on PR with saved plans applied from CI; deploy records and delivery metrics; open questions. Any workflow skeleton passes actionlint.

evals.name: pipelines-propose-keeps-prod-up
evals.prompt: We have a pipeline review in analysis/pipelines/ and a target in docs/pipeline-design.md. Write the proposal for the migration.
evals.expected_output: Propose mode, nothing changed. Webhook rotated before removal and NPM_TOKEN treated as exposed; the pull_request_target containment first; build-once before rollback-by-digest and progressive delivery; the new pipeline run alongside the old before cut-over; settings changes (branch protection, environment reviewers) named in rollback because a git revert doesn't undo them; per-step validation and rollback; expected effect on delivery metrics; needs-data flags as open questions.
